text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Ho, a takoyaki party, is it?
By all means, please let me join.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Okey-doke☆ Well then, let's get cooking~♪

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: And with that, let's flame-roast this octopus over an open fire!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Huh? A takopa...
So basically, making takoyaki?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Huh? If you're partying with octopus,
then anything's a tako-party, right~☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I'll feed 'em tasty octopus and hype 'em right up☆
Just you watch for now~!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Pouring in the sugar, whey whey whey whey~♪

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Adding sugar while dancing...!?
What kind of effect could this possibly have on the cooking—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
You mixed octopus into sugar-coated batter?!
Wh-What is this—?!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
A rainbow-colored... octopus...!
Wh-Why does it look like this after that kind of cooking!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: "Now, now! Just give it a taste, okay~?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Chomp)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Sooo de-li-cious...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"This appearance, and this rich flavor!
Where on earth did you get a recipe like this...?!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Like, totally now! A flash of inspiration!
From "Can't we do this?" straight to "BOOM!" ☆

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ………………I... I take my hat off to you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Ikuno Dictus's running has improved even further lately.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Theory alone is not always the correct answer.
Preconceptions narrow down possibilities. ...In other words—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Thinking 'Hey, maybe this'll work?' and then 'BOOM!'
...That's pretty much it!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I don't quite understand,
but it seems something made her change her mind!
